# Buddhicintaka (OPC) Private Limited

> A technology company based in Muzaffarpur, Bihar, India. We design, develop, and operate software products used across India.

- Legal name: Buddhicintaka (OPC) Private Limited
- GSTIN: 10AANCB2931M1ZQ
- Registered office: Phulwaria, Paroo, Muzaffarpur 843107, Bihar, India
- Email: mail.themonkeys.life@gmail.com
- Phone: +91 62030 96513
- Motto: Inspire, Inform, Innovate
- Class-I Local Supplier under the Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order, with 100% local content
- Registered vendor on the Government e-Marketplace (GeM)
- GitHub organisation: https://github.com/the-monkeys
- Managing Director and investor: Dave
- Occasional funding: Khushaboo Pandey, Shinu Joseph, Irak Rigia

## Products

- [Monkeys](https://monkeys.com.co): Open-source community and content platform for research, articles, events, groups, and Studio. Source: https://github.com/the-monkeys/the_monkeys
- [Aasriva](https://aasriva.in): Marketplace for Indian manufacturers and local artisans. Joint venture of Buddhicintaka and OSDuo Tech LLP.
